title: The Kitchen Studio
description: A bilingual website for a custom kitchen furniture studio in Glyfada, Greece. Statically generated with Astro 7 and Tailwind 4, with a dark mode, a bilingual blog and optimized AVIF galleries, deployed on Vercel.
features: Bilingual site: Greek (default) and English with i18n routing.
Hero crossfade slider with autoplay, arrow controls and quick links to each product category.
Product categories: kitchens, bathrooms, doors, wardrobes, tiles, and living.
Completed projects, design studies and showroom galleries with a lightbox.
Light and dark mode toggle that follows the system setting.
Bilingual blog and a homepage FAQ.
Contact page with a Formspree lead form and free appointment booking.
Structured data, a hreflang sitemap and llms.txt for search and AI visibility.
Content Security Policy and security headers, inline SVG icons, no client framework.
